closest_prior_work.relation: Swapping an opposite-number donor score alone had little average effect, but it did not swap same-number recipient-context scores or test whether a native score gates the donor payload.

Same-lemma and cross-noun values were nearly identical, ruling out lemma conditioning. It leaves the recipient PP-plural context, including its final-query-to-subject score, as the unresolved source of weak recovery.

novelty: Exact 2x2 source-term factorial crossing the native versus same-number opposite-syntax recipient score with native versus opposite-number subject value, applied at the original recipient. It asks whether cross-syntax QK scoring rescues the noun-general payload and reports task margin and CE in all four cells.
known_lessons_applied: A score is tested only through its causal product with the identified payload, not by its magnitude or variance.
The alternative score comes from the same noun and grammatical number, changing only the later recipient context.
The prior cross-noun payload arm must reproduce exactly; OOD remains closed.
No rank, reconstruction, or activation-energy metric is used.
